description: ZALF and nine crop-modelling groups published grain-maize and winter-wheat simulation outputs for the EU-27. The ensemble uses a historical 1980–2010 period and future 2040–2069 and 2070–2099 periods, with combinations of three climate pathways and five global climate models. Model variables include yield, crop growth, water use and heat or drought responses; not every crop model covers both crops or every mechanism. The ZALF GeoNode record opened under the dataset title, and its registry metadata lists CSV files and CC BY 4.0. A food-supply modeller could compare crop-model responses to climate stress or use the ensemble as scenario input. These are model outputs, not observations or established forecasts of future production. The geographic coverage is European, while the exact grid and completeness of each output variable need file-level checking. The data package was not downloaded, and no price was shown on the public record. The related earlier G4-0564 ZALF climate grid is a distinct weather-forcing resource; its relationship to every run in this ensemble has not been verified. No catalogue identity match appeared in the full local duplicate scan.
name: Diverging importance of drought stress for maize and winter wheat in Europe: Simulation Dataset
